queries.query: Bellevue Washington official parcel map GIS assessor property map
queries.result: Found City of Bellevue GIS/Open Data pages, the Bellevue Map Viewer, and King County's official parcel viewer and assessor map references. The City GIS page says property-boundary data is available through the Bellevue Open Data Portal and Map Viewer.

queries.query: Bellevue Washington official cadastral parcel data GIS
queries.result: The United States local/native-language variant is English. It found the City of Bellevue public ArcGIS parcel service and official City GIS documentation; no separate non-English cadastral custodian was evidenced.

source.name: City of Bellevue Enterprise Property Parcels ArcGIS MapServer
source.role: Local municipal GIS parcel-map custodian; King County is the county assessment/map authority referenced by the City's public GIS pages.
source.nativeIdentity: OBJECTID (OID); ParcelAFN is an additional source parcel identifier

attempts.route: City of Bellevue GIS/Open Data documentation and portal
attempts.outcome: Succeeded; official City GIS documentation identified the Bellevue Open Data Portal and Bellevue Map Viewer as public sources for property-boundary data.
Succeeded; organization search identified the Bellevue Enterprise Property Parcels service and layer.

attempts.route: ArcGIS REST layer metadata GET with f=pjson
attempts.outcome: Succeeded; polygon layer, schema, service extent, query capability, and native WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857 were observed. The layer contains address, taxpayer, valuation, and other unsafe fields; these were not requested or retained.

attempts.route: Anonymous exact-point intersects query at the immutable WUP point, inSR=4326, outFields=OBJECTID,ParcelAFN, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, f=geojson
attempts.outcome: Succeeded with zero features. This is an exact-point miss only and is not evidence of citywide absence; the coordinate was not shifted.

attempts.route: Anonymous bounded envelope query around central Bellevue, inSR=4326, outFields=OBJECTID,ParcelAFN, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3, f=geojson
attempts.outcome: Succeeded; three full parcel polygons were returned in a temporary ignored response cache. No sample GeoJSON was retained because sampling is optional and source-specific attributes were not needed in the packet.

qualification.citywideCoverage: The official service metadata extent and municipal GIS documentation support a Bellevue parcel layer, but this audit did not download or independently validate the complete citywide dataset or city-boundary clipping.
qualification.identityProvenance: OBJECTID is the service's native OID and ParcelAFN is a source parcel identifier; no synthetic row number was used. No identity was copied into retained GeoJSON because no sample was retained.
qualification.geometryProvenance: The bounded response was requested from the official Bellevue service with outSR=4326 and full polygon geometry; raw response remains only under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/.
uncertainty: The exact WUP point returned zero parcel features; this may reflect a road, water, boundary, or point-on-edge location and does not establish citywide absence.
The service schema includes fields that could expose address, taxpayer, and valuation information; those fields were explicitly excluded.
No adapter integration, source admission, login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe owner/address/title/tax request was used.
Packet completion records research outcomes only and does not constitute source integration or admission.
